title: Congress
context: Article I — the legislative branch. A bill must pass both chambers before the President can sign or veto it.

title: President
body: Enforces federal laws and runs the executive branch.
prompt: Who is in charge of the executive branch?
context: Article II — commander in chief, veto power, and head of federal agencies.

title: Courts
body: Interpret laws and decide if they follow the Constitution.
prompt: What does the judicial branch do?
context: Article III — judicial review was claimed by the Supreme Court in Marbury v. Madison (1803).
